concerns: Scope is exactly one file (smoke.txt); any second changed file is a defect the reviewer rejects.
Acceptance 2 (one review-requested extra line) is in-scope for THIS PR/issue, not a new issue.

implement: legion-worker: drives the implementer phase — jj commit, bookmark set, push, PR open, and the production-like `git show` proof that smoke.txt is the sole changed file with one added line.
dispatch: for issue-side messages/comments while landing the change.
review: legion-worker: drives the reviewer phase — enforce single-file scope, thread discipline, thermonuclear pair, and the approval gate; verify the in-scope Acceptance-2 follow-up line and thread resolution.
test: legion-worker: drives the tester phase — verify the implementer's `git show` proof, then re-run it / inspect merged smoke.txt as the tester's own E2E proof.

workflowRecommendation: Single implementer, single PR. Append exactly one line to smoke.txt at the repo root of sjawhar/legion-smoke; touch no other file. Implementer: jj commit the one-line append, set bookmark legion/S393721621-1, push, open PR with body line 'Dispatch: S393721621-1'; prove Acceptance 1 on the real surface with `git show <merge-or-head-sha> --stat` showing smoke.txt as the only changed file with a single added line; negative control: a diff that also touches a second file must draw REQUEST_CHANGES. If review asks for one more appended line (Acceptance 2), append that single line to the same smoke.txt on the same PR as in-scope work and resolve the thread; prove by reading merged smoke.txt for both lines. If smoke.txt is absent, create it containing only the one required line.
